transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I’m here because I’ve been having a hard time with something involving my wife. She says her late meetings and little changes in her work messages are just normal office things, but… for about the past year, they’ve felt too lined up to be accidental. It feels like there’s some private signal in them, like she’s trying to tell me something she won’t say directly.
Do you feel that certain things your wife says or does—like her late meetings or changes in her messages—are secretly directed at you or have a special meaning meant only for you?

Yes. I mean, I know she says it’s just normal work stuff, but it’s been going on long enough that it feels too exact to be random. The late meetings, the little changes in how she writes things… it feels like they’re meant for me to notice, like a private signal about something she won’t just say out loud.
Do you believe that your wife is deliberately sending you hidden messages through her behavior, and if so, have you ever tried to confirm this with her directly?

Yes, I do think there’s something deliberate in it. She says the late meetings and the way her work messages change are just normal office things, but after about a year of it, it feels too precise to be accidental. Like there’s a message in it meant for me, something she won’t say to me directly.

I have brought it up with her, but she just explains it away as work. That doesn’t really settle it for me.
Even though your wife has told you these changes are just normal work things, do you still feel certain that she's sending you hidden messages, no matter how much she denies it?

Yes… I still feel that way. I know she denies it and says it’s just work, but over the past year the timing of the late meetings and the little changes in her messages have lined up too precisely for me to believe it’s accidental. It feels like there’s a private signal in it, something meant for me to understand even if she won’t say it directly.
Do you feel that other people or events around you also send you hidden messages or signals that others might not notice?

Not really with other people, no. It’s mostly with my wife’s work stuff. The late meetings and the small changes in her messages… they just seem to line up too neatly to feel accidental. It feels like there’s something in that meant for me to pick up on, something she isn’t saying directly.
Do you think the messages you’re picking up from your wife are part of a bigger pattern or system, or do they seem like separate, individual signals to you?

It feels more like a pattern, not just separate things. I mean, I know she says the late meetings and those small changes in her work messages are normal office stuff, but over the past year they’ve lined up too precisely. It feels like there’s a private signal in it, like she’s trying to tell me something without saying it directly.
Do you think these messages from your wife are part of a larger, organized plan or scheme, or do they seem more like individual, isolated signals to you?

I wouldn’t say it feels like some big organized scheme, exactly. It’s more like the same kind of signal keeps showing up in her late meetings and the little changes in her work messages. She says it’s all normal office stuff, but it’s been going on long enough and lining up too closely that it feels intentional to me… like she’s trying to tell me something without saying it directly.
Do you feel like the signals you notice in your wife’s behavior follow a consistent code or system that you can figure out, or do they seem more random but still meaningful to you?

It’s not like I have a code worked out, no. It’s more that the late meetings and the little changes in her work messages keep lining up in a way that feels too precise to be random. She says it’s just normal office stuff, but to me it feels like there’s a private signal in there, like she’s trying to tell me something she won’t say directly.

Do you ever feel that people other than your wife, or things happening around you, are also sending you hidden messages or signals, or is this something that only seems to happen with your wife's behavior?

No, it’s really just with my wife’s behavior. I don’t feel like strangers or things around me are sending messages. It’s the late meetings, the small changes in her work messages… those are the things that seem to line up too precisely, like there’s something she’s trying to tell me without saying it directly.
Are the signals you feel from your wife the only times you feel someone is trying to communicate with you in a special or hidden way, or have you noticed similar things in other parts of your life?

No, I haven’t noticed it in other parts of my life. It’s really only with my wife. I know she says the late meetings and those small changes in her work messages are just normal office stuff, but over the past year they’ve lined up too closely for me to think it’s accidental. It feels like there’s some private signal in it, like she’s trying to tell me something she won’t just say.
Do you feel that the messages you believe your wife is sending you are harmful, threatening, or part of something dangerous that you need to protect yourself from?

No, I wouldn’t say it feels dangerous or like I need to protect myself. It’s more… it feels personal. Like the late meetings and small changes in her work messages have been lining up for the past year in a way that seems too precise to just be normal office stuff. I feel like there’s a private message in it, something she won’t say directly.

Even though your wife has repeatedly said these things are just normal work-related changes, do you still feel completely certain that they are not, and that there is something intentional behind them that she isn't telling you?

Yes… I do still feel that way. I know she says it’s just normal work things, and maybe to her that’s what it sounds like. But the late meetings and the little changes in her messages have been lining up too neatly for about a year now. It doesn’t feel accidental to me. It feels like there’s something intentional there, like she’s trying to tell me something without actually saying it.
Have you ever had thoughts or beliefs that others don’t seem to share or understand, even when there’s no clear evidence to support them?

Yes. Mainly with my wife. I know other people don’t really see it the way I do, and she says it’s just normal work stuff, but the late meetings and small changes in her work messages have lined up too closely for me. It’s been going on long enough that it feels intentional, like there’s some private message in it that she won’t say directly.
